description: Store a new post (draft or scheduled). Returns its ``post_id``.

cease_at.description: ISO-8601 stop time for recurrence; null = open-ended.

client_req_id.description:
Idempotency key — re-sending the same id returns the same
post without a second charge.

doc.description:
The editable Doc — a JSON object whose consumed key is ``blocks``,
a list of block objects. A minimal static post is one block:
``{"blocks": [{"text": "gm. stack sats.", "flags": []}]}``. Blocks
are joined with a blank line between them to form ``text_cache``.
Each block:
  - ``text`` (str): the block's copy (for a dynamic block, a prompt).
  - ``flags`` (list): editor highlight regions, each
    ``{"start": int, "end": int, "note": str, "colorIdx": int}``
    (char offsets into ``text``) — pass ``[]`` when there are none.
  - ``dynamic`` (bool, optional): when true ``text`` is a prompt the
    server resolves with an LLM at post time; ``fallback`` (str) is
    posted if it fails, and ``domains``/``maxFetches``/``runtimeLimit``
    bound its web access.
Voice/bans live in your separate Voice profile and the schedule in
``publish_at``/``recurrence``/``cease_at`` — neither belongs in ``doc``.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

publish_at.description: ISO-8601 first/next publish time; required when status='scheduled'.

recurrence.description:
``{"freq": "daily|weekdays|weekly|monthly", "interval": n}``
(``interval`` a positive integer) or null.

text_cache.description: Composed text (blocks joined) for scheduler + list excerpts.

title.description:
Optional human label for the post (up to 200 characters); the
list falls back to the first body line when it is blank.

tweet_url.description: URL of the tweet on X, for a post created already ``sent``.

name: excalibur_create_post
title: Create a post
